budget_semantics.client_starts: RootObservationStream::read serializes request, takes exclusive original stream, checks peer lifetime, then constructs min(Instant::now()+timeout, original session end) immediately before framed_exchange. The async send, peer handler wait, response receipt and transport JSON decode/final deadline check share that deadline.
budget_semantics.server_starts: HostAuthorityPeerChannel::exchange_inner waits for the first byte of the frame under session end, then constructs its per-frame deadline; remaining header, request body, synchronous original handler, response writes and final peer check share that original deadline.
budget_semantics.expiry_behavior: The client consumes/closes the original connection on expiry. The server does not forcibly cancel synchronous handler storage; post-handler and post-write checks refuse an overdue reply. The captured server error is a transport deadline error, not a helper lookup failure.

timing_evidence.mapping_method: A single failed-test stdout block; after the only timed command readback the test creates exactly one evidence client and performs exactly one evidence readback. C publication IDs6/7 have cut_receipts4; nested Selector publication IDs12/13/14/15 have cut_receipts3. The two whole Selector readback durations surround those nested reads. The fixed code awaits C prepare, predecessor reads, C post-prepare, predecessor post-reads serially. This supports a single-handler mapping as a code/log inference, not a complete runtime distributed trace.
timing_evidence.no_double_counting_rule: Do not add Selector nested publication IDs12-15 on top of their whole Selector remote-readback durations. The sum541148 uses only C IDs6/7 and two whole Selector durations.
timing_evidence.precise_limit: The 166541us Selector span ends after client timeout. There is no recorded start time to split it into before/after500ms portions. Thus541148 describes an inferred completed server-path subtotal including work after client cancellation, never measured work entirely inside the client interval.
timing_evidence.additional_inference: With the existing code, the late server result is consistent with a synchronous handler continuing after client cancellation and failing a final deadline check. The exact failing framer check cannot be selected from current logs.

helper_readiness_assessment.conclusion: No proven helper/readiness defect explains this failure. A new ready handshake could alter the client-side pre-service scheduling component, but cannot justify ignoring the original server per-frame DeadlineElapsed or make the completed live-owner work free. It is not a qualified fix for this captured failure.

performance_review.poll_evidence: OwnerChannel passes exact remaining Duration via Timespec::try_from into poll, multiplexes socket and pidfd, and uses the same absolute deadline on Interrupted/WouldBlock. No fixed sleep, millisecond conversion or retry-budget renewal exists in the inspected loop.
performance_review.measured_hot_region: Published-read owner_io timers surround read_original. In the evidence sequence C IDs6/7 report103702/131454us; Selector nested IDs12-15 report67993/58350/81591/75102us. These owner timers include required state/freshness work, not merely poll wait. CPU vs filesystem vs scheduler contribution is not distinguished by these timers.
performance_review.apparently_repeated_I_O: Observer remote readback brackets its journal with fresh C observations and fresh Trainer/Selector reads. Each Selector readback likewise brackets its journal with fresh publication and Trainer observations. Published read_original repeats task/source/selection checks on both sides of observation. These are explicit consistency/freshness checks, not demonstrated accidental duplicates.
performance_review.optimization_boundary: An optimization would need measurements inside read_original and proof that every original before/after freshness, owner-lifetime, request identity, signature and journal equality check stays in its original order and deadline. Current logs do not isolate a safely removable computation or prove a poll bug.
performance_review.smallest_evidence_only_followup: If requested in a separate review, enrich existing cfg(test) diagnostics with enclosing evidence request ID, channel/source ID, thread ID and monotonic start/end plus remaining budget around original subcalls; keep the original command, test roster, resource limits, read counts and500ms unchanged. This is observability, not a claimed fix or proposed qualification shortcut.
